data.description: A cannon golem is immune to spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance. Certain spells and effects function differently against it, as noted below. . Any spell with the water descriptor that affects a cannon golem renders its cannon unusable for 1 round (no save). . A heat metal spell causes the golem's cannon to instantly backfire, dealing 6d6 points of damage to the golem and staggering it for 1 round (no save).
